```{r functions, eval=TRUE, include=FALSE}
alg <- function(data) {
  if (dim(data)[1] <= 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat.col.number <- ncol(data)
  if (length(unique(data[, cat.col.number])) < 2 ||
    min(table(as.numeric(data[, cat.col.number]))) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  x <- data[, 1:(cat.col.number - 1)]
  y <- data[, cat.col.number]
  model_lambda <-
    glmnet(as.matrix(x),
      y,
      alpha = 1,
      family = "binomial"
    )
  if (is.null(model_lambda)) {
    cat("Model_lambda is null")
  }
  model_lambda
}

validF <- function(model, test) {
  cat.col.number <- ncol(test)
  if (is.null(model)) {
    cat("model is null\n")
    return(
      list(
        acc = max(table(test[, cat.col.number]) / dim(test)[1]),
        se = max(table(test[, cat.col.number]) / dim(test)[1]),
        sp = max(table(test[, cat.col.number]) / dim(test)[1])
      )
    )
  }
  AIC <- deviance(model) + 2 * model$df
  best_s <- which.min(AIC)
  x_test <- test[, 1:(cat.col.number - 1)]
  y_test <- test[, cat.col.number]
  new_x <- as.matrix(x_test)
  pred <- as.numeric(predict(
    model,
    newx = new_x,
    type = "class",
    s = model$lambda[[best_s]]
  ))
  conf_matrix <- table(
    Fact = y_test,
    Prediction = pred == levels(y_test)[[1]]
  )
  if (dim(conf_matrix)[[2]] == 1) {
    dim_name <- attributes(conf_matrix)$dimnames[[2]][[1]]
    if (dim_name == "TRUE") {
      tp <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[1]], "TRUE"]
      tn <- 0
      fp <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[2]], "TRUE"]
      fn <- 0
    } else {
      fn <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[1]], "FALSE"]
      tp <- 0
      tn <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[2]], "FALSE"]
      fp <- 0
    }
  } else {
    tp <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[1]], "TRUE"]
    tn <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[2]], "FALSE"]
    fp <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[2]], "TRUE"]
    fn <- conf_matrix[levels(y_test)[[1]], "FALSE"]
  }
  list(
    acc = (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn),
    se = tp / (tp + tn),
    sp = fp / (fp + tn)
  )
}

scientific_10 <- function(x) {
  y <- gsub("e-0", "e-", format(x, scientific = TRUE, trim = TRUE))
  y <- gsub("e\\+0", "e", y)
  text_labs <- gsub("e", " %*% 10^\"", paste0(y, "\""))
  zeros <- stri_startswith_fixed(text_labs, pattern = "0 %")
  text_labs[which(zeros)] <- "0"
  zeros <- stri_startswith_fixed(text_labs, pattern = "0.0 %")
  text_labs[which(zeros)] <- "0"
  na_s <- stri_startswith_fixed(text_labs, pattern = "NA")

  text_labs[which(na_s)] <- "NA"
  str2expression(text_labs)
}

get_acquisition_params <- function(path, outfile = stderr()) {
  ds_params <- stringi::stri_split_regex(basename(path), pattern = "\\.")[[1]]
  if (length(ds_params) < 5) {
    cat(
      "Failed to obtain acquisition parameters from the path given!\n",
      file = outfile
    )
    NULL
  }
  ds_expt <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[1]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_res <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[2]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_mode <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[3]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_dev <- as.integer(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[4]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]])
  ds_dev <- ds_dev[which(!is.na(ds_dev))]
  ds_range <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[5]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  list(
    expt_id = ds_expt,
    resol_id = ds_res,
    pol_id = ds_mode,
    dev_id = ds_dev,
    mzrange_id = ds_range
  )
}
align_spectra <- function(
  spectra, ref_scans, hw_size, tol_align, snr, verbose = FALSE
) {
  if (length(spectra) == 0) {
    return(spectra)
  }
  res <- tryCatch(
    MALDIquant::alignSpectra(
      spectra, reference = ref_scans, 
      halfWindowSize = hw_size, tolerance = tol_align, SNR = snr
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      failure_spectrum <- stringi::stri_extract_all_regex(
        e$message, pattern = "[\\d]+"
      )[[1]]
      if (length(failure_spectrum) > 0) {
        spec_num <- as.numeric(failure_spectrum[[1]])
        spec_files <- sapply(spectra, function(s) metaData(s)$file)
        spec_to_exclude <- which(
          spec_files == spectra[[spec_num]]@metaData$file
        )
        align_spectra(
          spectra[-spec_to_exclude], ref_scans,
          hw_size, tol_align, snr
        )
      } else {
        if (verbose) {
          cat(
            "Failed to align ", length(failure_spectrum),
            " spectra due to error: ", e$message, "\n"
          )
        }
        MALDIquant::createMassSpectrum(mass = c(0), intensity = c(0))
      }
    }
  )
  return(res)
}
```

# Задача

Задача заключается в определении того, как изменятся элементы вектора Шепли
сканов, если изменить для них метки классов на противоположные.

Смотрим на образцы с TCP = 100% и TCP = 0%.

Для каждого образца ткани создаем усредненный скан из исходных сканов и добавляем его в датасет для расчета вектора Шепли с меткой класса, противоположной метке исходных сканов.

В работе используются масс-спектрометрические данные, полученные с образцов тканей головного мозга человека с диагнозами \textbf{`r diags_info$name[[1]]`} и патологии не-опухолевой природы. Данные были получены с помощью масс-спектрометра Thermo LTQ XL Orbitrap ETD (Thermo Fisher Scientific; США) с картриджной ионизацией [@Pekov2021a; @bormotov_incorporation_2023].

Предварительная обработка масс-спектрометрических данных производилась с использованием параметров, указанных в таблице \ref{tab:paramstable}. Значения параметров взяты из результатов работы по определению оптимальных значений параметров предварительной обработки [@zavorotnyuk_determining_2024].

## Shapley calculation

### Sampling

Обеспечиваем выполнение условий:

  * сканы одного образца ткани не должны быть одновременно и в тренировочном, и в проверочном наборах данных;
  * в тренировочный набор данных попадают сканы всех картриджей образца "4622/19 2".
  
В датасет добавляем сканы по методу SMOTE [@chawlaSMOTESyntheticMinority2002]: выбираем сканы с TCP = 0% и 100%, создаем усредненные по образцам сканы и меняем таким усредненным сканам метки классов на противоположные.

Замену меток классов производим у половины сканов из каждого диагноза.

```{r sampling}
result_meta_data$class <- as.factor(result_meta_data$diagnosis)
tsamples <- result_meta_data %>%
  select(tissue, sample, diagnosis, tsample) %>% distinct()
probs <- rep_len(0.5, nrow(tsamples))
special_tissues <- c("4622/19 2")
special_idx <- which(tsamples$tissue %in% special_tissues)
if (length(special_idx) > 0) {
  probs[special_idx] <- 1
}
train_unique_samples <- sample(
  tsamples$tsample,
  size = 0.75 * nrow(tsamples),
  prob = probs
)
train_idx <- which(result_meta_data$tsample %in% train_unique_samples)
train_data_set <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  result_fm[train_idx, ],
  result_meta_data[train_idx, "class"]
))
train_meta_data <- result_meta_data[train_idx, ]
test_data_set <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  result_fm[-train_idx, ],
  result_meta_data[-train_idx, "class"]
))
names(train_data_set)[[dim(train_data_set)[[2]]]] <- "class"
train_data_set$class <- as.factor(train_data_set$class)
levels(train_data_set$class) <- levels(result_meta_data$class)
names(test_data_set)[[dim(test_data_set)[[2]]]] <- "class"
test_data_set$class <- as.factor(test_data_set$class)
levels(test_data_set$class) <- levels(result_meta_data$class)
test_meta_data <- result_meta_data[-train_idx, ]
df <- rbind(
  table(train_data_set[, dim(train_data_set)[[2]]]),
  table(test_data_set[, dim(test_data_set)[[2]]])
)
row.names(df) <- c("Train data set", "Test data set")
kable(
  df,
  format = "latex",
  row.names = TRUE,
  caption = "Train/Test data set scans count",
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```

```{r smote}
colMedian <- function(peaks) {
  apply(peaks, MARGIN = 2, FUN = median)
}
averaged_data_rds_file <- file.path(
  options$work_dir,
  "averaged_features.RData"
)
if (file.exists(averaged_data_rds_file)) {
  load(averaged_data_rds_file)
} else {
  smote_peaks_df <- as.data.frame(cbind(
    avg_fm,
    avg_meta_data$diagnosis
  ))
  names(smote_peaks_df) <- c(
    attr(result_fm, "mass"),
    "class"
  )
  avg_meta_data$class <- avg_meta_data$diagnosis
  sampled_smote_peaks <- avg_meta_data %>%
    slice_sample(prop = 1 / 2, by = class)
  sampled_smote_peaks$class <- ifelse(sampled_smote_peaks$class == 6, 32, 6)
  true_smote_peaks <- setdiff(avg_meta_data$idx, sampled_smote_peaks$idx)
  true_smote_peaks_idx <- which(avg_meta_data$idx %in% true_smote_peaks)
  fake_smote_peaks_idx <- which(!(avg_meta_data$idx %in% true_smote_peaks))
  smote_peaks_df$class[-true_smote_peaks_idx] <- sampled_smote_peaks$class

  df_info <- data.frame(
    scans_file = sub(
      "Neurosurgery/",
      "", avg_meta_data$file
    ),
    orig_class = avg_meta_data$diagnosis,
    mod_class = smote_peaks_df$class
  )
  kable(
    df_info, format = "latex",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Scans file", "Original label", "Modified label"),
    caption = "Averaged features labels distribution"
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
  save(
    true_smote_peaks_idx,
    fake_smote_peaks_idx,
    sampled_smote_peaks,
    smote_peaks_df,
    file = averaged_data_rds_file
  )
}
```

### Calculate ShapleyValue
```{r shapcalc}
train_test_rds_file <- file.path(
  options$work_dir,
  "train_test_set.Rdata"
)
if (file.exists(train_test_rds_file)) {
  load(train_test_rds_file)
} else {
  probs <- rep_len(0.5, length(train_idx))
  special_idx <- which(result_meta_data$tissue[train_idx] %in% special_tissues)
  if (length(special_idx) > 0) {
    probs[special_idx] <- 1
  }
  shap_train_idx <- sample(train_idx, size = 1500, prob = probs)
  shap_train_set <- as.data.frame(cbind(
    result_fm[shap_train_idx, ],
    result_meta_data[shap_train_idx, "class"]
  ))
  names(shap_train_set) <- c(
    attr(result_fm, "mass"),
    "class"
  )
  shap_train_set$class <- as.factor(shap_train_set$class)
  levels(shap_train_set$class) <- levels(result_meta_data$class)

  shap_test_set <- test_data_set %>% slice_sample(
    n = 255, by = class
  )

  shap_train_set <- rbind(
    shap_train_set,
    smote_peaks_df
  )
  kable(
    table(shap_train_set$class),
    format = "latex",
    caption = "Train set class distribution"
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
  kable(
    table(shap_test_set$class),
    format = "latex",
    caption = "Test set class distribution"
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
  save(
    train_idx,
    train_data_set,
    test_data_set,
    shap_train_idx,
    shap_train_set,
    shap_test_set,
    file = train_test_rds_file
  )
}
rdata_name <- file.path(
  options$work_dir,
  paste0(diags_info$id[[1]], "_", diags_info$id[[2]], "_tmp")
)
res <- dataShapleyI5_ext(
  shap_train_set, alg, validF, shap_test_set, .continue = TRUE,
  tol = 0.1, log.file = log_file, log.append = TRUE,
  rdata.name = rdata_name
)
saveRDS(
  res,
  file = file.path(
    options$work_dir,
    "shapley_results.rds"
  )
)
```
